text:
maria: quick thought — can we iterate on the /deploy bot so teams can opt into safer defaults by flag?
ken: like what defaults?
jordan: +1 to safer defaults. specifically: auto-dryrun, require-change-window, and version pinning prompts.
maria: exactly. idea: add a small shim that wraps /deploy and supplies three new flags: --confirm-pin, --auto-dryrun, --cw-lock. default off but org policy can flip.
ashley: also want a rollback heuristic: if post-deploy error rate > X for Y minutes, auto rollback to last pinned version unless someone acknowledges. keep it opt-in.
maria: prototyping a minimal CLI snippet — thoughts?

maria: ```
# deploy-wrapper.sh
# usage: deploy-wrapper.sh --service s --tag t [--auto-dryrun] [--confirm-pin] [--cw-lock]
if [ "$AUTO_DRYRUN" = "1" ]; then
  /deploy --service "$SERVICE" --tag "$TAG" --dry-run
  echo "Dry run complete — run again to execute or pass --confirm" && exit 0
fi
if [ "$CONFIRM_PIN" = "1" ]; then
  echo "Pinning candidate: $TAG for $SERVICE. reply 'pin' to confirm within 5m or abort."
  # small webhook to confirm
fi
/deploy "$@"
```

ken: nice. couple UX q's — how does pin-confirm work for CI? and how do we avoid blocking fastfixes during emergencies?
jordan: for CI we can default to no confirm unless repo is org-critical. emergency path could be /deploy --force-emergency which bypasses pin/lock and sets audit tag. auditable but allowed.
maria: agreed. propose policy table: repo label -> default flags (auto-dryrun yes/no, confirm-pin yes/no, cw-lock yes/no, emergency-bypass yes/no). store in central config repo.
ashley: for rollback heuristics: define metrics and thresholds. propose: if 5xx rate increases by 200% and p95 latency increases by >100ms sustained for 3 minutes, trigger rollout-back to last pinned version. notify #oncall and create incident stub.
sre-oncall: prefer slack confirm window before auto-rollback for non-critical alerts. auto-rollback ok for user-visible request flood/5xx storm. also need a dry-run of the rollback itself in staging.
maria: good call. I'll draft a small state machine and a deploy-bot command extension: `/deploy status --show-policy`, `/deploy pin --confirm <tag>`, `/deploy rollback --auto-heuristic` and `/deploy template-release --from-commit <sha>` which generates release notes from commit messages.

jordan: sample release note template generator idea: pull PR titles since last tagged release and auto-format. example output: "Release vX.Y.Z — fixes: foo; improvements: bar; migrations: none". People can edit before publish.

ashley: minor: pin confirmations should accept @mentions so team leads are reviewers. e.g., pin request pings @backend-team-lead and times out in 10m.

deploy-bot: scheduled: created pin-request #1234 for service payments/tag v2.7.1 — awaiting approval from @ken. Use `/deploy approve 1234` or `/deploy deny 1234`.

maria: next steps: i'll open an RFC PR in infra/deploy and a tiny prototype shim in tools/deploy-wrapper. can folks review the RFC by EOD Friday?

ken: I'll review. can you add a short migration plan for existing pipelines?

maria: yes — will include rollout plan, opt-in toggles per repo, and emergency bypass docs.

sre-oncall: add runbook snippets for rollback and for when the heuristic misfires.

jordan: 👍 let's also add telemetry events for pin/rollback/dryrun so billing/usage and chargebacks are visible.

maria: awesome, thanks all. I'll drop links here when PRs exist. :rocket:
